race.comment: AYE AYE CAPTAIN (5) talented mare who ran below expectations at Randwick when she failed to handle the heavy (9) track, finishing fifth with the 58kg. Maps to get the gun run again and can return to winning form in this easier contest. ENVIABLE (3) finally got her Maiden win out of the way first-up with an effortless victory over 1400m at Newcastle. Placed at Group level last campaign and will be savaging the line. MISS BUSSLINGER (1) kept fresh after she dropped in class with a slashing win from last on the turn over 1400m at Randwick Kensington on the heavy track. Deep into the prep and will appreciate Stanley's 3kg claim again. Value contender. TICKLEBELLY (2) gets a comfortable lead and due for a change of luck this time in. Proven at this trip and best figures should see her run well on the improving track. PIERATA'S GEM (9) fitter now and holds a forward position with the claim. Place best.
